name: eloquent
description: Professional voice-to-text desktop application with enhanced AI recognition, subscription management, and ultra-reliable pasting for macOS and Windows

scripts.reset-permissions: tccutil reset Microphone && tccutil reset Accessibility && echo '✅ Permissions reset. Please restart the app.'
scripts.backend:clean: cd backend-go && go clean && rm -f eloquent-backend
scripts.test:unit: node test/unit/syncManager.test.js && node test/unit/conversationProcessor.test.js && node test/unit/clipboard-service.test.js
scripts.validate:ast: node -c src/main.js src/preload.js src/main/*.js src/utils/*.js src/services/*.js src/core/*.js src/renderer/*.js src/renderer/utils/*.js src/renderer/components/*.js
scripts.ci:check: npm run build:ts && npm run validate:ast && npm run backend:test && npm test
